title: PET-CT IMAGING (FDG)
prerequisites: 6 hours of fasting required. Blood sugar level should be below 200mg/dl. Water is encouraged.
procedure: A small dosage of F-18 FDG is injected in your vein. After a resting uptake period of approximately 45–60 minutes, a whole-body PET CT scan is performed. The scan itself usually takes 20–30 minutes.
indications: Determine whether a cancer has spread in the body.
Assess the effectiveness of a treatment plan, such as cancer therapy.
Determine if a cancer has returned after treatment.
Determine blood flow to the heart muscle.

title: GALLIUM-68 PSMA SCAN
prerequisites: Fasting is generally not required. Please bring previous investigations (PSA reports, biopsy reports, imaging).
procedure: IV administration of a small radioactive Ga-68 PSMA agent. Waiting period of 60–90 minutes post injection, after which whole-body PET CT imaging is performed.

title: GALLIUM-68 OCTREOTIDE / DOTA / SOMATOSTATIN SCAN
prerequisites: Fasting is usually not required. Please bring previous PET/CT, MRI, CT, and pathology reports.
procedure: Special molecule designed to bind to somatostatin receptors paired with 68-Gallium is injected into the bloodstream. The PET CT produces 3D images of the tumor and its location.
indications: Detect neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) expressing somatostatin receptors.
Determine disease spread and tumor staging.

title: F-18 FDG PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fasting required for 4–6 hours before the scan.
Water is encouraged.
Diabetic patients should follow specific instructions provided by the doctor.
Bring previous reports and imaging studies.
procedure: A small amount of F-18 FDG radioactive tracer is injected through a vein. After a resting uptake period of approximately 45–60 minutes, a whole-body PET CT scan is performed. The scan itself usually takes 20–30 minutes. Patients should remain still during imaging.

title: GA68 PSMA PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fasting is generally not required.
Drink plenty of water.
Bring previous PSA reports, biopsy reports, and imaging.
procedure: Ga68 PSMA tracer is injected intravenously. Imaging is performed approximately 45–60 minutes after injection. Additional delayed images may be required in selected cases.

title: GA68 DOTA PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fasting is usually not required.
Bring previous PET/CT, MRI, CT, and pathology reports.
procedure: The Ga68 DOTA tracer is administered intravenously. Imaging begins after an uptake period of approximately 45–60 minutes. The scan covers the whole body.

title: CARDIAC PET SCAN
prerequisites:
Fast for 6–8 hours.
Avoid caffeine for 24 hours.
Certain heart medications may require temporary adjustment.
Follow physician instructions.
procedure: A radioactive tracer is injected to evaluate blood flow and heart muscle viability. Stress imaging may be performed using medication or exercise depending on clinical indication.

title: FAPI PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Usually no fasting required.
Stay well hydrated.
Bring previous imaging and pathology reports.
procedure: FAPI tracer is injected intravenously. Whole-body imaging is generally performed within 30–60 minutes after injection.

title: F-18 FDOPA PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fast for at least 4 hours.
Certain medications may need adjustment.
Bring previous neurological or oncology reports.
procedure: After intravenous injection of F-18 FDOPA, imaging is performed following an uptake period of approximately 60 minutes.

title: F-18 FDOPA PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fast for at least 4 hours.
Certain medications may need adjustment.
Bring previous neurological or oncology reports.
procedure: After intravenous injection of F-18 FDOPA, imaging is performed following an uptake period of approximately 60 minutes.

title: TRIVEHEXIN PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Follow physician-specific preparation.
Stay hydrated.
Bring previous medical records and imaging.
procedure: The tracer is injected intravenously. Imaging is performed after the recommended uptake period according to clinical protocol.

title: EXENDIN PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fast for 4–6 hours.
Blood sugar levels may be checked before the scan.
Bring previous endocrine investigations.
procedure: Exendin tracer is injected intravenously. Imaging is performed after an appropriate uptake period. Delayed imaging may occasionally be required.

title: EXENDIN PET CT SCAN
prerequisites:
Fast for 4–6 hours.
Blood sugar levels may be checked before the scan.
Bring previous endocrine investigations.
procedure: Exendin tracer is injected intravenously. Imaging is performed after an appropriate uptake period. Delayed imaging may occasionally be required.

title: FUSION PET MRI
prerequisites:
Fast for 4–6 hours (depending on tracer).
Remove all metallic objects.
Inform your doctor about implants, pacemakers, or claustrophobia.
Bring previous MRI, CT, PET, and laboratory reports.
procedure: A PET tracer is injected intravenously, followed by simultaneous PET and MRI imaging. This provides detailed anatomical and metabolic information with reduced radiation exposure compared to PET CT.

title: BONE SCAN
prerequisites: No Prerequisite.
procedure: 20 mCi of Tc 99m M.D.P. is administered intravenously and after 2.5 hours anterior and posterior images is acquired of the whole skeleton.
indications: Screen for bone metastases in patient with malignancy.
Evaluation of suspected fracture and stress fractures.
Evaluation of avascular necrosis and vascularity of bone graft.
Evaluates response to chemo, or radiation treatment for cancer.
Evaluation of prosthesis for loosening or infection.
Evaluation of nonspecific X-ray/ MRI bone signals.

title: BRAIN SPECT (CEREBRAL PERFUSION SCAN)
prerequisites: No PreRequisite.
procedure: Tc99m ECD is injected intravenously. Immediate SPECT images of the skull are acquired.
indications: Differential diagnosis of various forms of dementia.

title: POST CAPTOPRIL RENOGRAM (SUSPECTED RENAL ART. STENOSIS)
prerequisites: Good Hydration. Off medications 2-3 days prior study.
procedure: A) Baseline 4 mCi of Tc DTPA is injected intravenously after ensuring good hydration of the patient. Dynamic images are obtained for 31 minutes. B) Post Captopril Patient is given Tab. Enalapril & similar imaging protocol is followed 2 hours after the Baseline study.

title: COLLOID LIVER SCAN
prerequisites: No Prerequisite.
procedure: Tc 99m Phytate is injected intravenously and following that images in multiple projections (anterior, anterior with costal marker, posterior, right and left laterals and right and left oblique) are acquired of the abdomen.
indications: To assess hepatocellular dysfunction in diffuse liver disease.
Assess hepatic function in chronic alcoholics.

title: DIRECT CYSTOGRAM
prerequisites: No PreRequisite.

title: DMSA RENAL SCAN (CORTICAL FUNCTION)
prerequisites: Good Hydration.
procedure: Tc99m DMSA is injected intravenously after ensuring good hydration of the patient. Static images in posterior, LPO & RPO views are acquired at 2.5 hrs post injection.

title: DTPA RENOGRAM (GLOMERULAR FUNCTION) / EC (MAG-3) RENOGRAM (GLOM+ TUBULAR FUNCTION)
prerequisites: Good Hydration.
procedure: Tc99m DTPA is injected IV after ensuring good hydration of the patient. I.V. lasix is given after 10 mins of tracer injection. Sequential dynamic images are obtained for 31 minutes followed by post void and 1hour delayed image.
indications: Evaluation of unequal sized kidney / ? agenesis of kidney.
Indirect radio nuclide cystography of VU reflux.

title: HEPATOBILIARY SCINTIGRAPHY (HIDA SCAN)
prerequisites: No Prerequisite.
procedure: 2 mCi 99m Tc Mebrofenin is injected intravenously after skipping one normal feed. Dynamic images are obtained for 20 minutes. Second set of dynamic images are obtained post feed for 20 minutes. Delayed static images may be acquired till 24 hours if required.
indications: Congenital abnormalities of biliary tract disorders.
Evaluation of common bile duct obstruction.

title: MECKEL'S DIVERTICULUM IMAGING
prerequisites: 2–4 hrs fasting.
procedure: 99mTc is injected intravenously under the camera. Dynamic images are acquired for 30 minutes immediately thereafter of the anterior abdomen. Followed by static images of the LAO & RAO views. Post void static image of the abdomen is also acquired.
indications: Detection and localization of Meckel's Diverticulum.

title: MIBG SCAN
prerequisites: No PreRequisite.
procedure: Orally one tea spoon twice a day of Colloidal Iodine solution is started 2 days prior to injection and continued throughout the study. 131 I MIBG (Meta Iodo Benzyl Guanidine) is injected intravenously. Whole body views of the upper torso (Anterior and Posterior) are acquired at 24 & 48, 72 hours (5 mins each).
indications: TESTICULAR SCAN — Differentiating epididymitis from torsion.
Salivary Gland Scan — Stenosis of salivary gland for dryness of mouth.
Lymphoscintigraphy — To differentiate lymphoedema from venous pathology.

title: MILK SCAN (GE REFLUX)
prerequisites: No Prerequisite.
procedure: 99mTc-DTPA is fed orally to the patient mixed in 5 ml milk. & then unlabelled 50 ml milk is given to wash the esophagus and sequential dynamic images are acquired for 30 minutes (10sec/frame) immediately thereafter. Static anterior & posterior abdomen image was taken after 1 hour.
indications: Detection of GE reflux in infants having LRTI.

title: MUGA SCAN
prerequisites: No Prerequisite.
procedure: Evaluation of cardiac ventricular function and ejection fraction.

title: PARATHYROID SCAN
prerequisites: No Prerequisite.
procedure: 4 mCi of 99mTc(O4-) is injected intravenously. Sequential dynamic images and static blood pool at the 20th minute are acquired for the anterior neck. Without moving the patient, 20 mCi of 99mTc Sestamibi is injected intravenously. Static images at the 20th minute (Early) and 45 mins (Delayed) are acquired for the anterior neck.
indications: Evaluation of primary or secondary hyperparathyroidism.
Parathyroid adenomas or hyperplasia prior to surgical removal.

title: RADIO IODINE THERAPY
prerequisites: Patient should not eat or drink after midnight on the day of the procedure. If you have been taking anti-thyroid medications, you must stop at least three days before the therapy is given.
procedure: Radioactive Iodine I-131 therapy is administered for hyperthyroidism or thyroid cancer.

title: RBC BLOOD POOL SCAN / GI BLEED SCAN
prerequisites: No PreRequisite.
procedure: Invivo RBC Labeling Method: 20 minutes after the intravenous administration of stannous pyrophosphate (cold Kit), 10 mCi of 99m Tc (O4-) is injected intravenously. The patient is positioned supine covering the anterior abdomen. Perfusion images (2 sec/fr × 60 frames) are acquired, followed by dynamic images (1 min/fr × 60 frames). Thereafter, delayed static images are acquired. If required, TOMO (tomographic) images may also be acquired.
indications: Detection and localization of gastrointestinal bleeding.

title: STRESS & REST MYOCARDIAL PERFUSION IMAGING (THALLIUM SCAN)
prerequisites: Off beta blockers 48 prior the study. 4hrs fasting. No medication on the day of scan.
procedure: Patient has to undergo physiological / pharmacological stress. 99mTc Sestamibi is injected when patient achieves 85% THR. 45 mins post injection scan is performed. Almost after 1hour 99mTc Sestamibi is again injected to the patient in the resting position (SOS post nitrate). 45 mins post injection scan is performed.
indications: Prognosis of known coronary artery disease.
Risk stratification in known or suspected CAD.
Evaluation of PTCA / stent, anti – angina drugs.

title: THYROID SCAN
prerequisites: 2-4 days prior to test off Antithyroid medication. Fasting not required.
timeRequired: Total time: 1.5 Hours. Scanning Duration: 20 mins.
procedure: Tc99m Pertechnetate is injected intravenously, blood flow, blood pool and after 20 minutes static images will be acquired for anterior neck.
indications: Determination of thyroid size, function and position.
Evaluation of functional status of thyroid nodules.
Evaluation of Thyroid and neck masses.
Detection of ectopic thyroid eg. Lingual thyroid.
To detect retrosternal extension in MNG or large goiters.

title: I-131 WHOLE BODY SCAN
prerequisites: 3–4 weeks post total thyroidectomy. Off medication post surgery. Avoid Iodine intake 4–5 days prior to the scan.
procedure: Day 1: I-131 solution is given orally. Day 2: I-131 Whole Body Scan is performed.
indications: Detection of residual tissue in thyroid bed and local or distant thyroid mets after total thyroidectomy for Ca thyroid.
Assessment of response to I-131 therapy for Ca thyroid.
